<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>promote-todo-to-openspec</code></p>

Group selected todo.txt items into privacy-safe OpenSpec transformations and hold every proposed change for approval.

## When to use

Group and transform selected todo.txt items into approval-gated OpenSpec changes while preserving privacy and avoiding one-to-one promotion assumptions.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link promote-todo-to-openspec --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link promote-todo-to-openspec --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Classify todo.txt items before deciding whether they belong in OpenSpec.
- Propose zero-to-many and many-to-many transformations without losing operational or private work.

## Examples

### Review a mixed todo queue

**Prompt**

> Use the promote-todo-to-openspec skill to classify this todo.txt and propose separate transformations for my approval before changing files.

**Expected outcome**

Every item is accounted for while operational, unclear, private, and sensitive work remains outside shared specifications.

### Consolidate overlapping product intent

**Prompt**

> Use the promote-todo-to-openspec skill to map these overlapping todo.txt entries into existing or new OpenSpec changes without assuming one-to-one promotion.

**Expected outcome**

A coverage ledger presents merge, split, relocation, and preservation choices that can be accepted independently.
